rest_diff_vs_home_margin.note: Rest is derived from the game dates in this file only. Any earlier-season rest is unknown, so the first appearance of each team is dropped.

same_date_game_margins.note: Pairs are not independent (each game appears in several pairs), so the nominal p-value and Fisher interval understate uncertainty. The date-cluster bootstrap resamples whole slates and is the interval to use.

pbo.reason: Only 15 graded bets exist; CSCV requires >= 32 observations and >= 2 strategy series to estimate out-of-sample rank stability. No PBO value is published rather than a meaningless one.
